assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
The symptoms are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for extended rhythm assessment
CPT 93271 is the cardiac event monitoring study code
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-97
The claim is for Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271)
Payment for the service is bundled into another covered procedure
Separate reimbursement is not permitted under current policy guidelines
Appeals must be submitted in writing within the timeframe specified in plan documents
Supporting clinical documentation should be included to facilitate a timely review
